summary: awx.awx will be removed from Ansible 14 because it is being heavily refactored and doesn't meet community package standards, but can still be installed separately.
questions: Is awx.awx being removed from the Ansible package?
How do I install awx.awx after Ansible 14?

answer_card.title: awx.awx removal from Ansible 14
answer_card.answer_md:
`awx.awx` will be **removed from Ansible 14** because it is being heavily refactored and doesn't currently meet the community package standards. Afterwards, install it directly:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install awx.awx
```
